# Production Frontend Agent Rules (AGENTS.md Stub)

> Copy this file directly into your target frontend project root as `AGENTS.md`.

<!-- START AGENT-STANDARD: FRONTEND-PRODUCTION -->
## Core Frontend Principles
- [ ] Component Structure: Decouple UI presentation components from state/data-fetching logic.
- [ ] State Management: Server state managed via React Query / TanStack Query; client UI state via Zustand.
- [ ] Performance: Enforce dynamic imports for heavy components, zero unoptimized images, lazy loading.
- [ ] Accessibility & UI: Semantic HTML5, accessible ARIA attributes, keyboard navable.
